cases.evidence_note: Mutation fixture (lane mexist), expected values predicted by hand from the archived sources before running the evaluator. Inputs of x2pay.f4137.w9_government without the government-employee tips, and $5,000 of the unreported tips received in months when the total was under $20. Line 2 $9,000, line 3 $4,000, line 4 $5,000, line 5 $5,000; line 5 is not more than line 4, so line 6 is line 4 minus line 5, $0 (f4137 p. 1, lines 4-6), and line 12 is $0 x 1.45% = $0.

Mutation fixture (lane mexist), expected values predicted by hand from the archived sources before running the evaluator. Inputs of x2pay.f4137.w9_government without the government-employee tips, for a person with railroad retirement (RRTA) compensation. Form 4137 line 8 adds RRTA compensation to the social security wages, and tips for work covered by the Railroad Retirement Tax Act are not reported on Form 4137 (f4137 p. 2, "Don't use Form 4137 to report tips received for work covered by the Railroad Retirement Tax Act"); the tool refuses line 8 (refusal recorded from the evaluator). Line 12 (Medicare on line 6 = $4,700) is $68.15.

cases.evidence_note: Mutation fixture (lane mexist), expected values predicted by hand from the archived sources before running the evaluator. Inputs of x2pay.f4137.w9_government without the government-employee tips, with $6,000 of the $9,000 of cash and charge tips reported to the employer (the W-2 left as in the base). Line 2 $9,000, line 3 $6,000, line 4 $3,000, line 5 $300 (not more than line 4), line 6 $2,700 (f4137 p. 1, lines 2-6). Line 8 (W-2 boxes 3 and 7) $28,000, line 9 $176,100 - $28,000 = $148,100, line 10 the smaller of lines 6 and 9, $2,700; line 11 $2,700 x 6.2% = $167.40; line 12 $2,700 x 1.45% = $39.15; line 13 $206.55. Reported tips being more than the unreported tips does not refuse.
